featured_reviews.review_text:
I met Doc, Dr Yusuf Merchant Exactly 10 years back when I was just 17 years old. I was very confused about my life and quite destructive as a person. One meeting with Doc, despite how young I was, convinced me that I needed help and that this man would understand me and I could finally get a chance at being happy. I have had a wonderful and enriching experience with land ( the rehabilitation centre) and doc for over a decade now. The kind of things I learnt at that an early age shapes me into the person I am today and till date helps me to deal with life stressors.

The best part about the whole experience is the kind of support we get even after we leave the place. Once doc takes someone in recovery he is always available to us whenever we have other issues which we need guidance with. He is a call away for thousands of ex programmers and even our family's. It's amazes me till date, how one person can help and be there as a support to so many people and families.

The practises we learn at land are simple and very effective. They have worked for so many people to remain sober and also be happy at the same time. I don't think such a way of learning and support is available anywhere else and I count myself few of those lucky ones who found this magical place when I needed it the most.

If you or your family members are going through any kind of addiction or emotional issues, doc and land are sure to help you find a joyful and productive life where you will feel understood and and find friends for a lifetime.
